name: Notification Channel
description: A Teams channel alerts can be delivered to, identified by its Power Automate 'incoming webhook' URL. Create one row per Teams channel; Alert Subscriptions then pick which channel their alerts post to.

fields.label: Channel Name
fields.description: A friendly name, e.g. 'Alerts', 'Battery Ops', 'Safety'. This is what you pick on an Alert Subscription.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Where this delivers. Currently Microsoft Teams.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to stop delivering to this channel without deleting it.

fields.label: Default Channel
fields.description: Alerts whose subscription has no channel chosen post here. Keep exactly one channel marked as default.

fields.label: Teams Webhook URL
fields.description: The Power Automate 'When a Teams webhook request is received' URL for this channel. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Optional: which Teams team/channel this points at, who owns it, etc.
